statement: In a CI shell check that globs under a runner path, keep the variable part quoted and leave only the wildcard unquoted, as ("$DIR"/name.*); never compgen -G "$DIR/name.*", which reads the expanded value as a pattern. 2026-11-09, cejel #696, my own error: on windows-latest $RUNNER_TEMP is a backslash path (D:\a\_temp), so compgen -G took its backslashes as escapes and matched nothing. The tarball assertion failed although ls showed pnpm-9.0.0.tgz in the directory, and the pre-check meant to refuse a leftover cejel-pnpm directory could never fire on Windows, a pass by absence the failure happened to expose. Reproduced on macOS with a directory named bs2\a: old pre-check silent, new fires; old tarball check not found, new found. Fix (#696): array globs with the variable quoted, and a count and -s test on the result.
